info.name: Maso — Real-World Test Pack
info.description: Real-world redacted scam/spam emails, normalized derivatives, generated QR fixtures and synthetic benign controls. No malicious destinations are contacted. Select Maso Local; set api_key locally. Run sequentially with a 45000 ms timeout. Read README before interpreting quality tests.

exec: pm.test("Model is ready", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().ai, "Install and configure the model before analysis").to.eql("ready"); });
